data.description:
## Problem statement

`npx tsc --noEmit` (the `typecheck` script and the first half of `npm run build`) fails on the current `dev` HEAD:

```
src/scenes/core/CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts(2076,30): error TS2445: Property 'getBoss' is protected and only accessible within class 'GymBoss' and its subclasses.
```

Introduced by commit `f7a0c814` (AH-0MW9MN4ZO009GFKW, 'Remove duplicate advancePulseWave call from CombatScene._advanceBoss'), which added a pulse-wave speed parity test that calls `gymScene.getBoss()` directly. `CombatScene.getBoss()` is `protected` and `GymBoss` overrides it as `protected override`, so the call needs the structural cast the rest of the file already uses for the boss's private members.

## Impact

Every agent whose finish gate runs `npm run build` is blocked by a red typecheck that has nothing to do with their item, and dev's build is broken until it is fixed.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 on the fix.
- The pulse-wave speed parity test still asserts the same behaviour (no weakening or skipping).
- `/skill:test` changed-scope run is green.

## Impact

A red `tsc`/`npm run build` on `dev` no longer blocks every agent's finish gate.
data.title: dev typecheck is red: GymBoss.getBoss is protected in CombatScene.equivalence.test.ts
